content: Chroma Go syntax highlighter: lexers.Get(name) or lexers.Match(filename). styles.Get(name) for 700+ themes. formatters/terminal (ANSI output) or formatters/html. formatter.Format(w, style, iterator). Coalesce() merges adjacent same-type tokens. For terminal use: formatters.Get('terminal256') or 'terminal16m' for true color. Themes: 'github', 'github-dark', 'monokai', 'dracula'. LayeR chroma output with diff colors by processing ANSI strings after highlighting, then overlaying diff markup.
